Samira (AE): Heads-up — Helix POC wrap tomorrow 10:00am PT. Need final metrics + pricing ask for the execs. Quick sync?
Morgan (SE): On it. Can you drop the eval suite names we ran so I can pull the exact runs?
Samira (AE): Tests: intent_classify_v2, slot-fill-smoke, rerank-50. Main asks: p50/p95 latency, token cost breakdown, failure rate, and prompt pass rate on the eval set. Also need SOC2-ish Qs answered (data residency + KMS).
Eli (Sales Eng): Got it. Pricing note: customer expects a reserve + overage model. I’ll sketch a commit-based option and a pilot option. Need the token cost numbers to justify tiers.
Priya (CS): I’ll own the security Qs. @Samira do they require encryption-at-rest with customer KMS or is provider KMS ok?
Samira (AE): They insisted on customer-managed KMS + audit logs. EU residency required for pilot. Also asked about private deployment ETA (they want rough timeline).
Morgan (SE): Quick metric snapshot from the latest run:
```
p50: 120ms
p95: 330ms
failure_rate: 0.9% (mostly tokenization edge cases)
prompt_pass_rate: 91/100 (intent match)
avg_tokens_per_request: 420
token_cost_hosted_est: $0.0038 per 1k tokens
```
I'll upload full CSV.
Eli (Sales Eng): Nice — that token_cost maps to a $/1000 tier we can present. Draft pricing options I’ll propose in the slide deck:
- Pilot (30d, no commit): usage-based, list price + 15% premium
- Reserved (3/6/12m): commit GPU pool + discounted token rates
- Private deployment: additional infra fee + setup SOW
Will add estimated $ numbers after I see per-day token volumes.
Priya (CS): Security checklist for slides: data residency confirmation, KMS handoff steps, audit log retention, penetration test schedule. I'll confirm details with security team and post answers by EOD. security-bot: SOC2 questionnaire p1 responded (link: https://secure.internal/q1).
Samira (AE): For the readout slides I want 3 short ones: 1) Exec summary + blue square metric (go/no-go), 2) Metrics & gaps, 3) Expansion ask + pricing. Who takes which?
Morgan (SE): :raised_hand: I’ll do metrics + gaps slide. I’ll pull time-series and failure breakdown. CSV uploaded to Drive: https://drive.redwood/helix/metrics.csv
Eli (Sales Eng): I’ll draft pricing + expansion slide and include contract bullets (commit levels, SLA note, pilot conversion path).
Priya (CS): I’ll draft the security slide and include the KMS + residency steps. I’ll also attach the SOC2 snippet.
Samira (AE): Action items (quick):
- Morgan: full CSV + 1-line root-cause for failures (due 5pm PT)
- Eli: draft pricing bullets + high-level MRR/commit numbers to propose (due EOD)
- Priya: SOC2 answers + KMS plan (due EOD)
- Samira: final demo script + run-through 9am PT tomorrow
Eli (Sales Eng): Quick question — do we want to propose a short pilot discount to accelerate commit? I can show two decks: with/without pilot discount.
Samira (AE): Yes please, include both. Execs like obvious upside numbers.
Morgan (SE): One risk: rerank test had a few repeated failures on edge tokens, will include remediation note (tokenizer config + fallback).
Priya (CS): Security note — if they insist on on-prem, timeline is ~6-8 weeks for initial deployment + 2 weeks validation. Marking that in the slide.
Samira (AE): Cool. Can we all do a 20-min prep 9:00am PT tomorrow? If anything slips, ping me in this thread. Thanks team :thumbsup:
security-bot: Reminder — attach redacted SOC2 docs if sharing externally.
Samira (AE): Will do. See you tomorrow.
